aggregate.verdict: E2M1 expert weights are near-maximum entropy (3.8614/4.0 bits per nibble; theoretical limit 1.036x; measured zstd-19 1.03x; zero duplicate tiles across all samples). 3x lossless compression is information-theoretically IMPOSSIBLE for this data. The 49.7 GB/block K56 working set cannot be reduced by compression. Wide-K residency must come from BranchPack (reducing unique experts per block), CPU Dual-Rail (avoiding H2D for some experts), or projection splitting — not from byte reduction.

remaining_wide_k_solutions: Find K_RES where compute and transfer balance
implication_for_roadmap.hard_bandwidth_gate_recheck: With compression at only 1.03x, the ~3x traffic reduction target at K56 cannot be met by compression alone. If BranchPack and Dual-Rail are also insufficient, P3_PHYSICAL_BANDWIDTH_MISS becomes the likely branch (roadmap §56).
